review.assessment: This change provides only stub methods populated with `unimplemented!()`, meaning no actual storage or ring logic exists, and it includes zero test cases to verify behavior. Consequently, calling any method will panic immediately, and running tests yields nothing to execute. It completely fails to satisfy the requirement of implementing a functional fixed-capacity ring buffer.

findings.actual: Every public method call panics with "not yet implemented" because all bodies contain only `unimplemented!()`.
findings.defect: Missing implementation in all public methods
findings.expected: Methods return valid data or pass tests without panicking.

findings.actual: The acceptance check ran but found zero tests executed (0 passed; 0 failed; 0 measured), providing no verification of the API.
findings.expected: A suite of tests validating push, overwrite semantics, len(), is_empty(), and to_vec().
